verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents plain-language questioning across all data through Amplitude AI, and conversational answers with "no SQL, configuring dashboards, or waiting on the data team." An official MCP server also brings Amplitude into AI tools like Claude and Cursor, so the core natural-language interaction is clearly covered. Missing for 10: evidence that natural-language commands can take actions (e.g., create charts, cohorts, flags or experiments) rather than only answer questions, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the NL interface works as claimed.
